reason: I tried magnesium before and felt no difference, so a pretty pink-purple gummy with a new brand name and an Instagram ad doesn't make me believe it will do anything for me. I'd put my name down on the free list to hear more, but I wouldn't hand over £25 yet.
objection: I've already paid for magnesium that did nothing, and this one is sugary gummies, not sugar-free, from a brand I've never heard of. The 'finish your first jar' guarantee means I'd have to commit a month of sweets and money before I could ask for my money back.
would_change_my_mind: Independent proof that it works for tiredness or muscle cramps in women my age, plus a clear refund that doesn't require finishing the jar.
